name: DEATHTOPIA PRISON
source:
Andrew, the protagonist with amnesia, is immediately killed by a serial killer!?

This is a short game where you can enjoy serial killer characters and a dystopian world♪
Choose your options and become friends with the serial killers!
translation:
失忆的主角安德鲁立即被连环杀手杀害！？

这是一款可以享受连环杀手角色和反乌托邦世界的短游戏♪
选择你的选择并与连环杀手成为朋友！
